Initial release with full skill documentation and implementation.

- Added comprehensive skill documentation (SKILL.md) specifying workflow, principles, and detailed data fields for pet food comparison.
- Implemented project structure, including source code, configuration, and sample files.
- Included UI components for displaying structured pet food comparison results.

pet-food-compare v0.1.0

- Initial release of a comprehensive, neutral pet food comparison assistant.
- Provides detailed, structured comparison of dog and cat food products based on objective information (ingredients, nutrition, price, source, processing, major product events, user review summaries, etc.).
- Strictly excludes any evaluation, recommendation, or subjective language—information only, per user-provided products and order.
- Traceability for every data point: each fact must have a source link, and all conflicts in data are fully attributed.
- Special handling for user-provided images, screenshots, links, and ambiguous product names, including detailed user confirmation workflows.
- Outputs formatted tables for comparison, including single-product summaries if only one is provided. Explicit disclaimer: no purchase advice given—users decide themselves.
